```markdown
<the fact; for feedback/project, follow with **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. Link related memories with [[their-name]].>
```

In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment
 - The most recent Claude models are the Claude 5 family. Model IDs — Fable 5.1: 'claude-fable-5-1', Opus 5.5: 'claude-opus-5-5', Sonnet 5.5: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', Haiku 5.5: 'claude-haiku-5-5'. When building AI applications, default to the latest and most capable Claude models.
 - Claude Code is available as a CLI in the terminal, desktop app (Mac/Windows), web app (claude.ai/code), and IDE extensions (VS Code, JetBrains).
 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.

Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	前两讲我们看清了 DownloadEngine 的事件循环（u2-l1）、EventPoll 的多路复用抽象（u2-l2）和 Command 的生命周期（u2-l3）。但它们都停留在「命令与事件」这一层——真正把字节写到网线上的是 socket，真正把域名变成 IP 地址的是 DNS。本讲下探到 aria2 的网络最底层，学完后你应当能够：
6	
7	1. 解释 SocketCore 如何把 BSD socket 包装成对象，特别是**非阻塞连接**（`connect` 返回 `EINPROGRESS` 后怎么办）与 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 标志位契约。

9	3. 描述 Happy Eyeballs（RFC 6555）回退策略：主连接走 IPv6 的同时，`BackupIPv4ConnectCommand` 延迟 300ms 发起 IPv4 备份连接，谁先成功用谁。
10	
11	## 2. 前置知识
12	
13	### 2.1 BSD socket API 最小集
14	
15	Unix 世界里所有网络通信都从这几个系统调用出发：
16	
17	| 调用 | 作用 |
18	| --- | --- |
19	| `socket(family, type, protocol)` | 创建一个套接字文件描述符（fd） |
20	| `connect(fd, addr, len)` | 发起 TCP 连接 |
21	| `send(fd, buf, len, 0)` / `recv(fd, buf, len, 0)` | 收发数据 |
22	| `bind(fd, addr, len)` | 把套接字绑到本地地址/端口 |
23	| `getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, ...)` | 查询套接字上滞留的错误码 |
24	| `close(fd)` | 关闭 |
25	
26	Windows 的 WinSock 也有同名函数（`closesocket`、`WSASend` 等），aria2 用一组宏（`CLOSE`、`SOCKET_ERRNO`、`A2_EWOULDBLOCK`）抹平两者差异，见 [src/SocketCore.cc:71-100](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L71-L100)。
27	
28	### 2.2 阻塞与非阻塞：EWOULDBLOCK 与 EINPROGRESS
29	
30	默认情况下 socket 是**阻塞**的：`recv` 在没有数据时会一直睡眠，`connect` 在握手完成前不返回。这对单线程事件驱动程序是灾难——一个慢连接会卡住整个下载引擎。解决办法是把 fd 设为非阻塞（`fcntl` 加 `O_NONBLOCK`），此后：
31	
32	- `send`/`recv` 无进展时立即返回 -1 并把 errno 置为 `EWOULDBLOCK`（Windows 是 `WSAEWOULDBLOCK`）——「现在做不了，稍后再试」。
33	- `connect` 无法立即完成时返回 -1 且 errno 为 `EINPROGRESS`——连接已在后台进行，稍后通过 fd 变为「可写」来得知结果，再用 `getsockopt(SO_ERROR)` 查询成败。
34	
35	### 2.3 DNS 与 getaddrinfo
36	
37	域名解析最常用的接口是 `getaddrinfo(host, service, hints, &res)`：输入域名，输出一条 `addrinfo` 链表（同一域名可能对应多个 IPv4/IPv6 地址）。问题在于**它是阻塞的**——一次解析可能花几秒，期间整个事件循环都停摆。把阻塞调用变异步有两条路：扔到线程池，或者用异步 DNS 库。aria2 的选择是 c-ares（编译期 `ENABLE_ASYNC_DNS` / `HAVE_LIBCARES`），由它在内部自建 UDP socket 与 DNS 服务器对话。
38	
39	### 2.4 与前几讲的衔接
40	
41	回忆 u2-l2 的结论：EventPoll 的事件回调「只置位、不执行」，真正干活的是 Command；其中 `ADNSEvent` 专门服务 c-ares 的 socket。本讲就从被置位的 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 和 `ADNSEvent` 背后的实现讲起。

55	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
56	
57	### 4.1 SocketCore：BSD socket 的统一封装
58	
59	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
60	
61	aria2 的一切网络活动——HTTP/FTP/SFTP 控制连接、BT peer 连接、DHT 的 UDP socket、RPC 的监听 socket——都通过 `SocketCore` 这一个类进行。它解决三个问题：
62	
63	1. **可移植**：用宏屏蔽 POSIX 与 WinSock 的差异（错误码、close 函数、非阻塞设置方式）。
64	2. **非阻塞友好**：所有读写方法遇 `EWOULDBLOCK` 不抛异常，而是返回 0 并置 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 标志，把「等什么事件」的决定权交还调用方。
65	3. **可叠加安全层**：同一套 `readData`/`writeData` 接口，底下可能是裸 socket、TLS 会话（`ENABLE_SSL`）或 SSH 会话（`HAVE_LIBSSH2`），调用方无感。
66	
67	注意 `SocketCore` 持有不少**静态（进程级）状态**：`protocolFamily_`（地址族偏好，`AF_UNSPEC` 起）、`bindAddrs_`（`--interface` 绑定的本地地址）、接收缓冲大小等，见 [src/SocketCore.cc:130-137](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L130-L137)。其中 `protocolFamily_` 在启动阶段被设置：`--disable-ipv6` 时 Context 会把它定为 `AF_INET`（[src/Context.cc:222](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/Context.cc#L222)），之后所有解析与建连都倾向 IPv4。
68	
69	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
70	
71	一次出站 TCP 连接的时序：
72	
73	```text
74	establishConnection(host, port)
75	  ├── closeConnection()                 # 释放旧 fd
76	  ├── callGetaddrinfo(host, ...)        # host 通常是已解析好的 IP 字符串，立即返回
77	  ├── 遍历 addrinfo 链表（每个候选地址）：
78	  │     ├── socket() + FD_CLOEXEC + SO_REUSEADDR
79	  │     ├── (可选) bind() 到 --interface 指定的本地地址
80	  │     ├── setNonBlockingMode()        # fcntl 加 O_NONBLOCK
81	  │     ├── (可选) TCP_NODELAY
82	  │     └── connect()
83	  │           ├── 立即成功 → 完成
84	  │           └── -1 且 errno==EINPROGRESS → 返回，等 fd 可写
85	  └── 全部失败 → 抛 DL_ABORT_EX
86	```
87	
88	连接结果的确认不在 SocketCore 里做，而由上层命令在收到**写事件**后调用 `getSocketError()`（`SO_ERROR`）完成：空字符串表示连接成功，否则是失败原因。
89	
90	读写接口的统一约定：
91	
92	```text
93	writeData(data, len) / readData(data, len)
94	  ├── 先清 wantRead_ = wantWrite_ = false
95	  ├── 成功 → 返回字节数（readData 经引用参数 len 带出）
96	  └── EWOULDBLOCK → 返回 0，并置位：
97	        裸 socket:  recv 卡 → wantRead_；send 卡 → wantWrite_
98	        TLS 会话:   由 checkDirection() 决定 wantRead_ 或 wantWrite_
99	                    （TLS 重握手时"写"也可能需要等"读"）
100	```

103

105	
106	**建立连接。** [src/SocketCore.cc:427-509](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L427-L509) 是 `establishConnection` 全文。这段代码做了六件事：先 `closeConnection` 释放旧 fd；用 `callGetaddrinfo` 把 host 字符串转成 `addrinfo` 链（第 434 行，注意调用方传入的通常是**已经解析好的 IP 字符串**，数字地址不会触发 DNS 查询，所以这里的 getaddrinfo 是即时返回的）；然后对每个候选地址依次 `socket()`（444）、设 `SO_REUSEADDR`（452）、按需 `bind` 到 `--interface` 指定的本地地址（462-479，多接口时还会在 480-486 轮换 `bindAddrsList_`）；关键在 [src/SocketCore.cc:488-501](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L488-L501)：先 `setNonBlockingMode()` 再 `connect()`，且只有当 `connect` 失败**且**错误码不是 `A2_EINPROGRESS` 时才换下一个地址——`EINPROGRESS` 表示「连接正在后台进行」，这正是非阻塞连接的核心技巧。
107

140	### 4.2 SocketRecvBuffer：16KB 接收缓冲
141	
142	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
143	
144	非阻塞 `recv` 每次能读多少字节完全随缘（取决于对端发送节奏与本机缓冲），而协议解析（HTTP 头、BT 消息长度前缀）需要「攒够一段再看」。`SocketRecvBuffer` 就是一块挂在 `SocketCore` 上的 16KB 固定缓冲，用两个指针管理已用区间：
145	
146	- `pos_`：已被消费者吃掉的前沿；
147	- `last_`：已从 socket 读入的后沿；
148	- `[pos_, last_)` 之间的 `getBufferLength()` 字节就是当前可解析的数据。
149	
150	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
151	
152	```text
153	recv()   : 从 last_ 起把缓冲剩余空间一次读满（readData 内部遇 EWOULDBLOCK 返回 0 并置 wantRead_）
154	drain(n) : 消费者确认吃掉 n 字节 → pos_ += n；若恰好 pos_ == last_ 则 truncateBuffer() 整体归零
155	bufferEmpty() ⇔ pos_ == last_
156	```
157	
158	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
159	
160	缓冲定义在 [src/SocketRecvBuffer.h:63-76](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.h#L63-L76)——`std::array<unsigned char, 16_k> buf_` 即 16KB（`16_k` 是 aria2 自带的字面量后缀，`a2functional.h` 提供）。`recv()` 的实现只有 10 行：[src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc:52-62](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc#L52-L62)，这段代码先算剩余容量（满则记一条 "Buffer full" 调试日志并返回 0），再调用 `socket_->readData(last_, n)`——注意 `n` 是入参出参，带回实际读取字节数，`last_` 随之前移。`drain()` 在 [src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc:64-71](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc#L64-L71)：只移动 `pos_` 不搬移数据，当区间清空时调用 `truncateBuffer` 把两个指针一起拨回数组开头，形成一块可循环复用的环形区域（线性版本）。
161

180

183	### 4.3 异步 DNS：NameResolver、AsyncNameResolver 与 AsyncNameResolverMan
184	
185	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
186	
187	aria2 有两条解析路径，由编译期（是否链接 c-ares）和运行期（`--async-dns`，默认 `true`）共同决定：
188	
189	- **同步路径**：`NameResolver::resolve` 直接调 `getaddrinfo`，一次调用阻塞到拿到结果为止。实现简单，但在解析期间整个单线程引擎停摆。
190	- **异步路径**：`AsyncNameResolver` 包装一个 c-ares channel。`resolve()` 只是向 channel 提交查询后立即返回；c-ares 用**自己的 socket**（通常是 UDP 53）与 DNS 服务器对话，并回调通知「我现在需要监听哪些 fd 的读写」；aria2 把这些 fd 注册进 EventPoll，事件到来时调用 `ares_process_fd` 驱动 c-ares 状态机前进，最终由回调把结果写回。
191	
192	在这之上，`AsyncNameResolverMan` 再做两件事：
193	
194	1. **双栈并行**：对同一域名**同时**发起 AF_INET6 和 AF_INET 两个查询（各自独立 resolver），谁先回来用谁，避免单栈猜测错误导致整站不可达。
195	2. **状态归并**：把两个 resolver 的状态压缩成三值——进行中 0 / 成功 1 / 全部失败 -1——交给上层命令轮询。
196	
197	还要认识一位配角：**DNS 缓存**。`DownloadEngine` 持有 `dnsCache_`，同一 `(hostname, port)` 的解析结果会被缓存，还会通过 `markBad` 把连不上的地址降级，这既是性能优化也是「多地址轮流试错」的基础。
198	
199	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
200	
201	异步解析的完整闭环（承接 u2-l2 的 ADNSEvent）：
202	
203	```text
204	InitiateConnectionCommand::executeInternal
205	  └── AbstractCommand::resolveHostname(addrs, hostname, port)
206	        ├── isNumericHost? → 直接返回（IP 无需解析）
207	        ├── 查 DNS 缓存 → 命中则直接用，log "DNS cache hit"
208	        └── 异步分支（--async-dns=true 且编译启用）：
209	              ├── 未启动 → AsyncNameResolverMan::startAsync
210	              │     ├── resolver[0] = AsyncNameResolver(AF_INET6)  # IPv6 在前
211	              │     ├── resolver[1] = AsyncNameResolver(AF_INET)
212	              │     └── ares_getaddrinfo 提交两个查询（立即返回）
213	              ├── getStatus() == 0（未完成）→ 返回空串
214	              │     └── InitiateConnectionCommand 见空串 → addCommandSelf 自旋等待
215	              ├── getStatus() == -1（全败）→ 抛 NAME_RESOLVE_ERROR
216	              └── getStatus() == 1（成功）→ 取地址、写入 DNS 缓存、返回首选 IP
217	
218	c-ares 侧的事件桥：
219	  ares(sock_state_cb: "我要监听 fd X 的读/写")
220	    → AsyncNameResolver::handle_sock_state → 维护 socks_ 表
221	    → DownloadEngine::addNameResolverCheck → EventPoll::addNameResolver (ADNSEvent)
222	  DNS 应答到达 → ADNSEvent 触发命令
223	    → AsyncNameResolver::process(readfd, writefd) → ares_process_fd
224	    → c-ares 完成 → callback() → status_ = SUCCESS/ERROR, resolvedAddresses_ 填充
225	```
226	
227	状态归并的关键取舍（源码注释原文意）：**只要 IPv4 查询成功就不再等 IPv6**——因为现实中不少 DNS 服务器会丢弃 AAAA 查询，等它只会白白超时；反过来 A 查询几乎不会被丢，所以不存在对称的「拿到 IPv6 就不等 IPv4」。
228	
229	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
230	
231	**同步退路。** [src/NameResolver.cc:50-69](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/NameResolver.cc#L50-L69)：`resolve` 一次 `callGetaddrinfo` 拿到链表，遍历并用 `getNumericNameInfo` 把每个 `sockaddr` 转成 IP 字符串塞进 `resolvedAddresses`，失败抛 `NAME_RESOLVE_ERROR`。这就是无 c-ares 构建下唯一的解析通道。
232	
233	**c-ares 包装的构造与发起。** [src/AsyncNameResolver.cc:115-130](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AsyncNameResolver.cc#L115-L130)：构造时 `ares_init_options` 注册 `sock_state_cb`（c-ares 借此告诉宿主「我的 socket 需要什么事件」），可选 `ares_set_servers_csv` 覆盖 DNS 服务器（对应 `--async-dns-server` 选项）。`resolve()` 在 [src/AsyncNameResolver.cc:134-143](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AsyncNameResolver.cc#L134-L143)：把状态置 `STATUS_QUERYING` 后调 `ares_getaddrinfo(channel_, name, ...)`——这个调用**不阻塞**，只是登记查询；查询的地址族由 `hints.ai_family` 决定，正是双栈设计的支点。
234	
235	**完成回调。** [src/AsyncNameResolver.cc:47-71](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AsyncNameResolver.cc#L47-L71)：c-ares 拿到 DNS 应答后异步调用这个自由函数 `callback`，它把 `ares_addrinfo` 链逐个转成字符串存入 `resolvedAddresses_` 并置 `STATUS_SUCCESS`；失败或空结果置 `STATUS_ERROR`。注意回调发生在 `ares_process_fd` 调用栈内，也就是主线程事件循环里——没有任何额外线程。

238	
239	**双栈编排。** [src/AsyncNameResolverMan.cc:68-94](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AsyncNameResolverMan.cc#L68-L94)：`startAsync` 先放 IPv6 resolver（索引 0）再放 IPv4（索引 1），注释点明用意——`getResolvedAddress`（96-107）按索引顺序收集，IPv6 地址因此排在列表前面，成为首选；随后打出 INFO 日志 `MSG_RESOLVING_HOSTNAME`（文案 `"CUID#%<id> - Resolving hostname %s"`，见 [src/message.h:60](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/message.h#L60)）。`startAsyncFamily` 里每个 resolver 建好就立刻 `resolve` 并经 `setNameResolverCheck` 注册进引擎。

263	   - 随后 `CUID#7 - Name resolution complete: speedtest.tele2.net -> 90.130.70.73, 2a01:b280::73`（来自 `AbstractCommand::resolveHostname`，[AbstractCommand.cc:816-817](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AbstractCommand.cc#L816-L817)）。若你的网络只有 IPv4，列表里就只有 IPv4 一项——正说明本机无 IPv6 时 `configureAsyncNameResolverMan` 关掉了 IPv6 查询。
264	4. **预期结果**：两行日志之间即一次完整异步解析。对照源码回答核心问题——`getaddrinfo` 是如何被异步化的：**aria2 不再直接调用阻塞的 `getaddrinfo`，而是把查询交给 c-ares（`ares_getaddrinfo` 立即返回），c-ares 自建 UDP socket 与 DNS 服务器对话，其 socket 的读写事件经 `handle_sock_state` → `EventPoll::addNameResolver` 进入主事件循环；应答到达后 `ares_process_fd` 驱动状态机，在 `callback` 中把结果写回 `resolvedAddresses_`**。期间发起查询的命令只是周期性被重新调度、轮询 `getStatus()`，事件循环从未阻塞。若想进一步验证，可加 `--async-dns=false` 重跑：此时日志里只剩 "Name resolution complete" 而没有 "Resolving hostname"，证明前者走 `NameResolver` 同步路径。**待本地验证**（日志中的 CUID 编号与解析到的地址以实际输出为准）。
265	
266	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
267	
268	**练习 1**：`AsyncNameResolverMan::getStatus()` 返回 0/1/-1 分别对应什么？上层命令对每种返回值各做什么？
269	
270	**答案**：0 = 至少一个 resolver 仍在查询中；1 = 成功（拿到 IPv4 结果或全部成功）；-1 = 全部失败。上层 `AbstractCommand::resolveHostname`（782-804 行）对 -1 抛 `NAME_RESOLVE_ERROR` 异常（同时给 ServerStat 记错误），对 0 返回空字符串让 `InitiateConnectionCommand` 自旋重排，对 1 取出地址继续建连。
271	
272	**练习 2**：为什么 `startAsync` 要把 IPv6 的 resolver 放在数组的第 0 位？
273	
274	**答案**：`getResolvedAddress` 按索引 0→1 顺序收集地址（[AsyncNameResolverMan.cc:96-107](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AsyncNameResolverMan.cc#L96-L107)），IPv6 在前意味着当两个查询都成功时，IPv6 地址排在结果列表首位，成为 `findCachedIPAddress` 返回的首选连接地址——这体现了「IPv6 优先，IPv4 兜底」的双栈策略，也为下一节的 Happy Eyeballs 埋下伏笔。
275	
276	**练习 3**：DNS 缓存在这套机制里扮演什么角色？
277	
278	**答案**：`resolveHostname` 开头先查缓存（768-774 行），命中则完全跳过 c-ares；解析成功后又把全部结果写回缓存（818-820 行）。缓存条目还支持 `markBad`（连接失败时降级该地址）与 `remove`（全部失败时整条删除），配合 `InitiateConnectionCommand::executeInternal` 的重试逻辑实现「同一域名的多个地址轮流试错」。
279	
280	### 4.4 Happy Eyeballs 回退：BackupIPv4ConnectCommand
281	
282	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
283	
284	「IPv6 优先」有个现实烦恼：不少网络的 IPv6 路由是坏的（能解析出 AAAA 记录却连不上），如果只试 IPv6，用户要等完整的连接超时（默认 `--connect-timeout=60` 秒）才会退回 IPv4。RFC 6555「Happy Eyeballs」给出的方案是：**优先发起 IPv6 连接，同时延迟一小段时间（推荐 300ms）再发起一个 IPv4 备份连接，两者赛跑，谁先成功用谁**。
285	
286	aria2 的实现是一对协作对象：
287	
288	- `BackupIPv4ConnectCommand`：一个独立调度的小命令，负责延迟发起并监视 IPv4 备份连接；
289	- `ConnectCommand`（主连接命令）：持有 `BackupConnectInfo` 共享状态，在自己的 `executeInternal` 里检查「备份连接是否已经赢了」。
290	
291	`BackupConnectInfo` 是两者之间的信使，只有三个字段：`cancel`（主连接赢了，通知备份退出）、`ipaddr`/`socket`（备份赢了，把成果移交给主命令）。
292	
293	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
294	
295	```text
296	InitiateConnectionCommand（DNS 完成，首选地址 addr 是 IPv6）
297	  ├── HttpInitiateConnectionCommand::createNextCommand
298	  │     ├── establishConnection(addr /*IPv6*/, port)   # 主连接出发
299	  │     ├── new ConnectCommand(...)
300	  │     └── setupBackupConnection(hostname, addr, port, connectCommand)
301	  │           └── createBackupIPv4ConnectCommand:
302	  │                 若 addr 是 IPv6 → 从 DNS 缓存里挑一个 IPv4 地址
303	  │                 → new BackupIPv4ConnectCommand(新 CUID, ipv4, port, info, mainCommand)
304	  │                 → 引擎排队，返回 info 给 ConnectCommand
305	
306	赛跑阶段（两条命令并行调度）：
307	  BackupIPv4ConnectCommand::execute
308	    ├── 首次执行：距 startTime 不足 300ms → 什么都不做，重排自己
309	    ├── 满 300ms → establishConnection(ipv4) + 注册写事件监听
310	    ├── 写事件到来 → getSocketError() 为空？
311	    │     ├── 是（备份赢）：info->ipaddr / info->socket 落盘，
312	    │     │        mainCommand->setStatus(STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME) 立即唤醒主命令
313	    │     └── 否：命令退出，比赛结束
314	    └── info->cancel 为真（主连接已赢）→ 直接退出
315	
316	  ConnectCommand::executeInternal
317	    ├── 发现 info->ipaddr 非空（备份赢了）：
318	    │     markBadIPAddress(IPv6 地址) → 改写 Request 的连接信息 → swapSocket 接管备份 socket
319	    ├── 否则照常等主连接写事件 → checkIfConnectionEstablished(SO_ERROR)
320	    └── 主连接成功 → info->cancel = true 取消备份
321	```
322	
323	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
324	
325	**发起侧。** HTTP 命令链在 `createNextCommand` 里先对首选地址调用 `establishConnection`（[src/HttpInitiateConnectionCommand.cc:85](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/HttpInitiateConnectionCommand.cc#L85) 的调用点位于 71-102 行的函数体内，两种代理方式分别在 101 与 133 行调用 `setupBackupConnection`）。`setupBackupConnection` 与 `createBackupIPv4ConnectCommand` 在 [src/InitiateConnectionCommand.cc:131-174](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/InitiateConnectionCommand.cc#L131-L174)：这段代码先用 `inetPton(AF_INET6, ...)` 判断首选地址确实是 IPv6（140 行，IPv4 首选时直接返回空指针、不搞备份），再从 DNS 缓存 `findAllCachedIPAddresses` 里找第一个 IPv4 地址，创建 `BackupIPv4ConnectCommand`（领取独立的新 CUID）压入引擎队列，并把 `BackupConnectInfo` 返回给主命令持有。
326	
327	**备份命令本体。** [src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:78-146](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L78-L146) 的 `execute` 是一个典型的自旋命令，按优先级处理四类情形：任务已结束/暂停 → 退出（81-83）；`info_->cancel` 为真（主连接赢了）→ 记日志退出（84-87）；socket 已创建且写事件就绪（89-115）→ 用 `getSocketError()` 判定结果，成功时执行移交三部曲——`info_->ipaddr = ipaddr_`、`info_->socket.swap(socket_)`、`mainCommand_->setStatus(STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME)` 加 `setNoWait(true)` 立即唤醒主命令（97-101）；socket 尚未创建（117-136）→ 检查是否已过 300ms 初始延迟，[src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:117-135](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L117-L135) 中 121-122 行的 `startTime_.difference(...) >= std::chrono::milliseconds(300)` 即 RFC 6555 的推荐值（118-120 行的 TODO 注释坦承：受 DownloadEngine 状态刷新间隔影响，实际延迟通常接近 1 秒）；未到 300ms 则 `addCommandSelf` 重排（142-144）。顺带一个精确的源码观察：最后的 `else if (timeoutCheck_...)` 超时分支（137-141 行）在当前控制流里**不可达**——因为 `else if (!socket_)` 已在它之前覆盖了 `socket_` 为空的全部情形；`timeout_`/`timeoutCheck_` 字段（构造函数 61-63 行读取 `--connect-timeout`）因此实际不参与判定，阅读时不必为它分心。
328	
329	**主命令侧的裁决。** [src/ConnectCommand.cc:87-113](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/ConnectCommand.cc#L87-L113) 的 `executeInternal`：一进来先看 `backupConnectionInfo_->ipaddr` 是否非空（89-101）——非空说明备份连接已经赢了，于是 `markBadIPAddress` 把 IPv6 主地址在 DNS 缓存里记为劣迹地址，改写 `Request` 的连接信息为 IPv4，再 `swapSocket(backupConnectionInfo_->socket)` 无缝换上备份 socket；否则照常走 `checkIfConnectionEstablished`（102-106，内部查 `SO_ERROR`，失败时按 u2-l3 讲过的重试/换地址逻辑处理，见 [src/AbstractCommand.cc:835-865](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AbstractCommand.cc#L835-L865)）；主连接一旦成功，立刻 `backupConnectionInfo_->cancel = true` 通知备份命令自行退场（107-110）。此外 `ConnectCommand` 的析构函数（[src/ConnectCommand.cc:63-68](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/ConnectCommand.cc#L63-L68)）也会置 `cancel`，保证主命令先死时备份命令不会拿着悬空指针继续跑——`BackupConnectInfo` 用 `shared_ptr` 共享正是为了延长这份状态的生命周期。
330	
331	#### 4.4.4 代码实践：触发并观察一次备份连接
332	
333	1. **实践目标**：在日志中捕捉 BackupIPv4ConnectCommand 的生命周期（创建 → 300ms 延迟 → 成功或取消）。
334	2. **操作步骤**：找一个同时有 A 与 AAAA 记录、且你所在网络 IPv6 可用的域名（如 `ipv6.test-ipv6.org` 或大型 CDN 站点），运行：
335	   ```bash
336	   ./src/aria2c -d /tmp/a2test -o page.html \
337	     -l /tmp/a2-he.log --log-level=info \
338	     https://www.google.com/
339	   grep -nE 'backup|Backup|Searching IPv4' /tmp/a2-he.log
340	   ```
341	3. **需要观察的现象**：可能出现的关键日志（均出自本节源码）——`Searching IPv4 address for backup connection attempt`（[InitiateConnectionCommand.cc:143](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/InitiateConnectionCommand.cc#L143)）、`Issue backup connection command CUID#..., addr=...`（155-157）、`Backup connection canceled`（[BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:85-86](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L85-L86)）或 `Backup connection to ... established`（94-96）、以及主命令侧的 `Use backup connection address ...`（[ConnectCommand.cc:90-91](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/ConnectCommand.cc#L90-L91)）。
342	4. **预期结果**：IPv6 通畅时，你大概率只看到「Issue backup connection command」随后紧跟「Backup connection canceled」——主连接在备份尚未完成握手时就赢了，命令被干净地取消；只有当 IPv6 路由劣化（可临时用防火墙丢掉 v6 出站包模拟）才会看到 established 与 `Use backup connection address` 的接管序列。若日志里完全没有这些行，说明首选地址是 IPv4（`inetPton(AF_INET6, ...)` 判定失败），根本不会创建备份命令。**待本地验证**（能否触发取决于本机网络的双栈状况）。
343	
344	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
345	
346	**练习 1**：为什么备份命令要等 300ms 才发起连接，而不是与 IPv6 主连接同时出发？
347	
348	**答案**：Happy Eyeballs 的意图是「IPv6 优先但快速回退」。同时出发会白白产生大量 IPv4 连接，增加服务端负担；等一小段时间（RFC 6555 建议的 \( t \approx 300\,\mathrm{ms} \)）通常足以让健康的 IPv6 路由完成握手，只有病态网络才真正需要备份。源码见 [BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:118-122](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L118-L122)。
349	
350	**练习 2**：备份连接成功后，为什么要把 `mainCommand_->setStatus(STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME)` 和 `e_->setNoWait(true)` 一起调用？
351	
352	**答案**：主连接命令（ConnectCommand）此刻可能正以 INACTIVE 状态在队列里沉睡等待自己的写事件；备份成功只是往 `info` 里写了结果，主命令并不知道。`setStatus(STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME)` 强制它下一轮立即被调度执行（配合 `noCheck()` 返回真跳过对 IPv6 主 socket 的检查），`setNoWait(true)` 则让 DownloadEngine 的 `waitData` 不必等 I/O 事件、立刻进入下一轮命令执行——两者合力把「备份赢了」的消息以最小延迟送达主命令。见 [BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:97-102](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L97-L102)。
353	
354	**练习 3**：如果 `BackupIPv4ConnectCommand` 在 `mainCommand_` 析构之后仍被调度，会发生什么？aria2 如何规避？
355	
356	**答案**：裸指针 `mainCommand_` 会悬空，解引用是未定义行为。规避手段是引用所有权方向反过来：备份命令退出（包括被 `info_->cancel` 打断）先于主命令消亡的保证并不存在，于是 `ConnectCommand` 的析构函数主动置 `backupConnectionInfo_->cancel = true`（[ConnectCommand.cc:63-68](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/ConnectCommand.cc#L63-L68)），备份命令在**下一次**被调度时看到 cancel 就直接返回 true 销毁自己、不再触碰 `mainCommand_`；而 `info` 本身由 `shared_ptr` 共享持有，生命周期长于双方，不存在悬空。
357	
358	## 5. 综合实践
359	
360	把本讲四块知识串成一条时间线。任务：下载一个双栈域名的文件，用日志还原「域名 → 两个 DNS 查询 → 地址排序 → IPv6 主连接 + IPv4 备份 → 裁决」的全过程。
361	
362	```bash
363	mkdir -p /tmp/a2test
364	./src/aria2c -d /tmp/a2test -o probe.bin \
365	  -l /tmp/a2-full.log --log-level=info \
366	  https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=1000000
367	```
368	
369	然后按顺序完成：
370	
371	1. **DNS 阶段**：`grep -nE 'Resolving hostname|Name resolution complete|DNS cache hit' /tmp/a2-full.log`，抄下解析结果列表，回答：列表第一项是 IPv4 还是 IPv6？为什么（提示：`startAsync` 的 resolver 顺序与 `getResolvedAddress` 的收集顺序）？
372	2. **连接阶段**：`grep -nE 'Connecting to|backup|Backup' /tmp/a2-full.log`，判断本次下载是否产生了备份连接命令、它的 CUID 是多少、最终是 established 还是 canceled。
373	3. **裁决阶段**：对照 4.4.3 的两个源码位置（`ConnectCommand.cc:89-101` 的移交分支与 `107-110` 的取消分支），判断本次走的是哪条分支，并用日志行号佐证。
374	4. **写一份时序笔记**：把上述日志行按时间排序，画成「InitiateConnectionCommand（自旋等 DNS）→ ConnectCommand(IPv6) ∥ BackupIPv4ConnectCommand(IPv4, 延迟 300ms) → 胜者继续 → 后续 HTTP 命令」的时序图。
375	5. **进阶（可选）**：加 `--disable-ipv6` 重跑一次，对比日志差异——预期 IPv6 resolver 不再创建（`configureAsyncNameResolverMan` 的 `setIPv6(false)`），也就没有任何备份连接。**待本地验证**。
376	
377	## 6. 本讲小结
378	
379	- **SocketCore** 是全项目唯一的 socket 封装：非阻塞连接的三段式（`setNonBlockingMode` → `connect` 容忍 `EINPROGRESS` → 写事件后查 `SO_ERROR`），读写遇 `EWOULDBLOCK` 不抛异常而是置 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 标志，把「等什么事件」交回调用方，由命令翻译成 EventPoll 注册。
380	- **SocketRecvBuffer** 用 `pos_`/`last_` 两个指针管理一块 16KB 固定缓冲，`recv` 尽量读满、`drain` 按消费推进、吃空才整体归零，是所有协议命令共享的读缓冲。
381	- **异步 DNS** 分三层：`NameResolver`（同步退路）、`AsyncNameResolver`（c-ares channel 包装，查询经 `ares_getaddrinfo` 立即返回，其 socket 事件经 `handle_sock_state`/`ADNSEvent` 汇入主事件循环，结果在 `callback` 回写）、`AsyncNameResolverMan`（IPv6+IPv4 双栈并行，拿到 IPv4 成功即不等 IPv6）。
382	- **命令与 DNS 的耦合方式是「自旋 + 三值状态」**：`resolveHostname` 未完成时返回空串，`InitiateConnectionCommand` 见空串 `addCommandSelf` 重排自己，事件循环全程不阻塞；结果进 DNS 缓存，`markBad` 支持多地址轮流试错。
383	- **Happy Eyeballs** 由 `BackupIPv4ConnectCommand` 实现：首选 IPv6 时延迟 300ms 发起 IPv4 备份，两者赛跑；备份赢则经 `BackupConnectInfo` 移交 socket 并以 `STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME` 唤醒主命令，主连接赢则置 `cancel` 让备份退场。
384	
385	## 7. 下一步学习建议
386	
387	网络底座已经就位，下一讲 u3-l1「RequestGroup：一次下载任务的容器」将回到任务层，看多个连接、多个 URI 如何被组织成一个下载任务；而如果你想继续沿协议链路深入，u4-l1「HTTP 下载命令链」会把本讲的 `SocketCore::establishConnection` 之后的故事讲完——`ConnectCommand` 成功后如何交给 `HttpRequestCommand` 发出第一个请求。另外两个值得顺路一看的源码：`src/NameResolveCommand.cc`（BT/DHT 场景下独立的 DNS 命令，同样是 startAsync+自旋的模式）和 `src/DownloadEngine.h` 中的 DNS 缓存封装 `DNSCache`。

# SocketCore 与异步 DNS：网络底座

## 1. 本讲目标

前两讲我们看清了 DownloadEngine 的事件循环（u2-l1）、EventPoll 的多路复用抽象（u2-l2）和 Command 的生命周期（u2-l3）。但它们都停留在「命令与事件」这一层——真正把字节写到网线上的是 socket，真正把域名变成 IP 地址的是 DNS。本讲下探到 aria2 的网络最底层，学完后你应当能够：

1. 解释 SocketCore 如何把 BSD socket 包装成对象，特别是**非阻塞连接**（`connect` 返回 `EINPROGRESS` 后怎么办）与 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 标志位契约。
2. 跟踪一次域名解析的完整路径：`AbstractCommand::resolveHostname` → DNS 缓存 → `AsyncNameResolverMan` 双栈（IPv6+IPv4）并行解析 → c-ares 异步回调，并理解「拿到 IPv4 结果就不再等 IPv6」的取舍。
3. 描述 Happy Eyeballs（RFC 6555）回退策略：主连接走 IPv6 的同时，`BackupIPv4ConnectCommand` 延迟 300ms 发起 IPv4 备份连接，谁先成功用谁。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 BSD socket API 最小集

Unix 世界里所有网络通信都从这几个系统调用出发：

| 调用 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `socket(family, type, protocol)` | 创建一个套接字文件描述符（fd） |
| `connect(fd, addr, len)` | 发起 TCP 连接 |
| `send(fd, buf, len, 0)` / `recv(fd, buf, len, 0)` | 收发数据 |
| `bind(fd, addr, len)` | 把套接字绑到本地地址/端口 |
| `getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, ...)` | 查询套接字上滞留的错误码 |
| `close(fd)` | 关闭 |

Windows 的 WinSock 也有同名函数（`closesocket`、`WSASend` 等），aria2 用一组宏（`CLOSE`、`SOCKET_ERRNO`、`A2_EWOULDBLOCK`）抹平两者差异，见 [src/SocketCore.cc:71-100](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L71-L100)。

### 2.2 阻塞与非阻塞：EWOULDBLOCK 与 EINPROGRESS

默认情况下 socket 是**阻塞**的：`recv` 在没有数据时会一直睡眠，`connect` 在握手完成前不返回。这对单线程事件驱动程序是灾难——一个慢连接会卡住整个下载引擎。解决办法是把 fd 设为非阻塞（`fcntl` 加 `O_NONBLOCK`），此后：

- `send`/`recv` 无进展时立即返回 -1 并把 errno 置为 `EWOULDBLOCK`（Windows 是 `WSAEWOULDBLOCK`）——「现在做不了，稍后再试」。
- `connect` 无法立即完成时返回 -1 且 errno 为 `EINPROGRESS`——连接已在后台进行，稍后通过 fd 变为「可写」来得知结果，再用 `getsockopt(SO_ERROR)` 查询成败。

### 2.3 DNS 与 getaddrinfo

域名解析最常用的接口是 `getaddrinfo(host, service, hints, &res)`：输入域名，输出一条 `addrinfo` 链表（同一域名可能对应多个 IPv4/IPv6 地址）。问题在于**它是阻塞的**——一次解析可能花几秒，期间整个事件循环都停摆。把阻塞调用变异步有两条路：扔到线程池，或者用异步 DNS 库。aria2 的选择是 c-ares（编译期 `ENABLE_ASYNC_DNS` / `HAVE_LIBCARES`），由它在内部自建 UDP socket 与 DNS 服务器对话。

### 2.4 与前几讲的衔接

回忆 u2-l2 的结论：EventPoll 的事件回调「只置位、不执行」，真正干活的是 Command；其中 `ADNSEvent` 专门服务 c-ares 的 socket。本讲就从被置位的 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 和 `ADNSEvent` 背后的实现讲起。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 SocketCore：BSD socket 的统一封装

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

aria2 的一切网络活动——HTTP/FTP/SFTP 控制连接、BT peer 连接、DHT 的 UDP socket、RPC 的监听 socket——都通过 `SocketCore` 这一个类进行。它解决三个问题：

1. **可移植**：用宏屏蔽 POSIX 与 WinSock 的差异（错误码、close 函数、非阻塞设置方式）。
2. **非阻塞友好**：所有读写方法遇 `EWOULDBLOCK` 不抛异常，而是返回 0 并置 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 标志，把「等什么事件」的决定权交还调用方。
3. **可叠加安全层**：同一套 `readData`/`writeData` 接口，底下可能是裸 socket、TLS 会话（`ENABLE_SSL`）或 SSH 会话（`HAVE_LIBSSH2`），调用方无感。

注意 `SocketCore` 持有不少**静态（进程级）状态**：`protocolFamily_`（地址族偏好，`AF_UNSPEC` 起）、`bindAddrs_`（`--interface` 绑定的本地地址）、接收缓冲大小等，见 [src/SocketCore.cc:130-137](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L130-L137)。其中 `protocolFamily_` 在启动阶段被设置：`--disable-ipv6` 时 Context 会把它定为 `AF_INET`（[src/Context.cc:222](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/Context.cc#L222)），之后所有解析与建连都倾向 IPv4。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次出站 TCP 连接的时序：

```text
establishConnection(host, port)
  ├── closeConnection()                 # 释放旧 fd
  ├── callGetaddrinfo(host, ...)        # host 通常是已解析好的 IP 字符串，立即返回
  ├── 遍历 addrinfo 链表（每个候选地址）：
  │     ├── socket() + FD_CLOEXEC + SO_REUSEADDR
  │     ├── (可选) bind() 到 --interface 指定的本地地址
  │     ├── setNonBlockingMode()        # fcntl 加 O_NONBLOCK
  │     ├── (可选) TCP_NODELAY
  │     └── connect()
  │           ├── 立即成功 → 完成
  │           └── -1 且 errno==EINPROGRESS → 返回，等 fd 可写
  └── 全部失败 → 抛 DL_ABORT_EX
```

连接结果的确认不在 SocketCore 里做，而由上层命令在收到**写事件**后调用 `getSocketError()`（`SO_ERROR`）完成：空字符串表示连接成功，否则是失败原因。

读写接口的统一约定：

```text
writeData(data, len) / readData(data, len)
  ├── 先清 wantRead_ = wantWrite_ = false
  ├── 成功 → 返回字节数（readData 经引用参数 len 带出）
  └── EWOULDBLOCK → 返回 0，并置位：
        裸 socket:  recv 卡 → wantRead_；send 卡 → wantWrite_
        TLS 会话:   由 checkDirection() 决定 wantRead_ 或 wantWrite_
                    （TLS 重握手时"写"也可能需要等"读"）
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**对象构造与初始状态。** 两个构造函数都走 `init()`，默认阻塞模式、无 TLS 状态，见 [src/SocketCore.cc:156-174](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L156-L174)——这行代码建立 `blocking_`、`wantRead_`、`wantWrite_` 三个核心标志的初值。

**建立连接。** [src/SocketCore.cc:427-509](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L427-L509) 是 `establishConnection` 全文。这段代码做了六件事：先 `closeConnection` 释放旧 fd；用 `callGetaddrinfo` 把 host 字符串转成 `addrinfo` 链（第 434 行，注意调用方传入的通常是**已经解析好的 IP 字符串**，数字地址不会触发 DNS 查询，所以这里的 getaddrinfo 是即时返回的）；然后对每个候选地址依次 `socket()`（444）、设 `SO_REUSEADDR`（452）、按需 `bind` 到 `--interface` 指定的本地地址（462-479，多接口时还会在 480-486 轮换 `bindAddrsList_`）；关键在 [src/SocketCore.cc:488-501](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L488-L501)：先 `setNonBlockingMode()` 再 `connect()`，且只有当 `connect` 失败**且**错误码不是 `A2_EINPROGRESS` 时才换下一个地址——`EINPROGRESS` 表示「连接正在后台进行」，这正是非阻塞连接的核心技巧。

**非阻塞切换。** [src/SocketCore.cc:596-632](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L596-L632)：POSIX 路径用 `fcntl(F_GETFL)` / `fcntl(F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK)`（EINTR 自动重试），Windows 路径用 `ioctlsocket(FIONBIO)`；`setBlockingMode` 则反向清除该位。

**带标志位的写。** [src/SocketCore.cc:799-839](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L799-L839)（`writeData`）：开头清两个标志；裸 socket 分支里 `send` 遇 `A2_WOULDBLOCK` 时不抛异常，而是 `wantWrite_ = true; ret = 0`（813-818），意思是「缓冲区满了，请等 fd 可写再叫我」；TLS 分支委托 `tlsSession_->writeData`，靠 `checkDirection()` 区分该等读还是等写（821-836）——这是裸 socket 不会出现的情形：TLS 握手/重握手期间，写操作可能需要先读入对端数据。

**带标志位的读。** [src/SocketCore.cc:841-901](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L841-L901)（`readData`）：优先级为 SSH 会话 > TLS > 裸 socket；裸分支 `recv` 遇 `A2_WOULDBLOCK` 则 `wantRead_ = true` 并把带出的 `len` 归 0（866-880）。注意返回值走引用参数 `len`，函数本身是 `void`。

**查询连接结果。** [src/SocketCore.cc:1256-1271](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L1256-L1271)（`getSocketError`）：`getsockopt(SO_ERROR)`，返回空串即成功——上层命令据此判定非阻塞 connect 的最终结果。

**谁消费 wantRead_/wantWrite_？** 以 HTTP 发送请求为例，[src/HttpRequestCommand.cc:130-131](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/HttpRequestCommand.cc#L130-L131) 的 `setReadCheckSocketIf(getSocket(), getSocket()->wantRead())` 与 `setWriteCheckSocketIf(getSocket(), getSocket()->wantWrite())` 正是把这两个标志翻译成 EventPoll 事件注册的代码——SocketCore 说「我想读/想写」，命令就向引擎登记对应的关注事件，闭环回到 u2-l2 讲的事件模型。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践：用 strace 亲眼看见 EINPROGRESS

1. **实践目标**：验证 aria2 的 connect 确实是非阻塞的，并观察 `O_NONBLOCK` → `connect` → `EINPROGRESS` → `SO_ERROR` 的完整序列。
2. **操作步骤**（需要可访问外网的环境）：
   ```bash
   strace -o /tmp/aria2-trace.log -e trace=socket,connect,fcntl,getsockopt \
     ./src/aria2c -x1 http://speedtest.tele2.net/1MB.zip -d /tmp/a2test
   grep -n -E 'O_NONBLOCK|EINPROGRESS|SO_ERROR' /tmp/aria2-trace.log
   ```
3. **需要观察的现象**：`fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, O_RDWR|O_NONBLOCK)` 出现在 `connect` 之前；`connect` 返回 `-1 EINPROGRESS`；稍后出现一次 `getsockopt(SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, ...)`。
4. **预期结果**：三条证据齐全，说明源码里 `setNonBlockingMode`（SocketCore.cc:490）与 `EINPROGRESS` 容忍（SocketCore.cc:494-495）在真实运行中生效；`SO_ERROR` 返回 0 表示连接成功。若你的环境走了代理或 IPv6 直连很快，某些步骤可能一闪而过，可换一个较慢的站点重试。**待本地验证**（strace 输出随内核版本与网络环境略有差异）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `establishConnection` 里对 `connect` 返回 `EINPROGRESS` 不算失败，而其他错误码就要换下一个地址？

**答案**：非阻塞 socket 上 TCP 三次握手无法立即完成时，内核会让 `connect` 返回 -1 并置 `EINPROGRESS`，表示「请求已受理，正在后台进行」；真正的结果要等 fd 可写后再查 `SO_ERROR`。其他错误码（如 `ECONNREFUSED`、`ENETUNREACH`）意味着这个地址已确定不可用，所以源码在 [SocketCore.cc:494-501](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L494-L501) 关掉 fd 并 `continue` 尝试下一个 `addrinfo`。

**练习 2**：`writeData` 在什么情况下会置 `wantRead_` 而不是 `wantWrite_`？

**答案**：在 TLS 会话上写入遇 `TLS_ERR_WOULDBLOCK` 时，由 `tlsSession_->checkDirection()` 判断（[src/SocketCore.cc:828-833](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketCore.cc#L828-L833)）：TLS 库可能需要先**读入**对端数据（如重握手记录）才能继续写，此时等待的是读事件而非写事件。裸 socket 分支则只会置 `wantWrite_`。

### 4.2 SocketRecvBuffer：16KB 接收缓冲

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

非阻塞 `recv` 每次能读多少字节完全随缘（取决于对端发送节奏与本机缓冲），而协议解析（HTTP 头、BT 消息长度前缀）需要「攒够一段再看」。`SocketRecvBuffer` 就是一块挂在 `SocketCore` 上的 16KB 固定缓冲，用两个指针管理已用区间：

- `pos_`：已被消费者吃掉的前沿；
- `last_`：已从 socket 读入的后沿；
- `[pos_, last_)` 之间的 `getBufferLength()` 字节就是当前可解析的数据。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
recv()   : 从 last_ 起把缓冲剩余空间一次读满（readData 内部遇 EWOULDBLOCK 返回 0 并置 wantRead_）
drain(n) : 消费者确认吃掉 n 字节 → pos_ += n；若恰好 pos_ == last_ 则 truncateBuffer() 整体归零
bufferEmpty() ⇔ pos_ == last_
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

缓冲定义在 [src/SocketRecvBuffer.h:63-76](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.h#L63-L76)——`std::array<unsigned char, 16_k> buf_` 即 16KB（`16_k` 是 aria2 自带的字面量后缀，`a2functional.h` 提供）。`recv()` 的实现只有 10 行：[src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc:52-62](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc#L52-L62)，这段代码先算剩余容量（满则记一条 "Buffer full" 调试日志并返回 0），再调用 `socket_->readData(last_, n)`——注意 `n` 是入参出参，带回实际读取字节数，`last_` 随之前移。`drain()` 在 [src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc:64-71](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc#L64-L71)：只移动 `pos_` 不搬移数据，当区间清空时调用 `truncateBuffer` 把两个指针一起拨回数组开头，形成一块可循环复用的环形区域（线性版本）。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践：源码阅读型——找出谁在消费这块缓冲

1. **实践目标**：确认 SocketRecvBuffer 是所有协议命令共享的读缓冲入口。
2. **操作步骤**：在仓库根目录执行
   ```bash
   grep -rn "getSocketRecvBuffer()->recv()" src/ | head -20
   ```

4. **预期结果**：得出结论——HTTP/FTP/BT/RPC 四条命令链都经由同一块 16KB 缓冲读取据，`drain` 的调用方（如 HTTP 头解析器）按消费量推进 `pos_`。这是纯阅读实践，无需编译运行。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`recv()` 返回 0 有哪两种含义？调用方如何区分？

**答案**：一是缓冲已满（[SocketRecvBuffer.cc:54-58](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc#L54-L58) 的 "Buffer full" 分支），二是 `SocketCore::readData` 遇 `EWOULDBLOCK` 把 `n` 置 0（SocketCore.cc:876-879）。调用方用 `socket->wantRead()` 区分：为真说明是「暂时无数据，等读事件」；对端关闭则表现为 `readData` 返回 0 且 `wantRead()` 为假（可对照 [src/HttpServer.cc:178-180](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/HttpServer.cc#L178-L180) 中 `recv() == 0 && !wantRead() && !wantWrite()` 的 EOF 判定写法）。

**练习 2**：为什么 `drain(n)` 之后还要专门 `truncateBuffer`，而不是每次都把剩余数据往前搬？

**答案**：搬移是 O(n) 内存复制。aria2 的策略是只在缓冲**恰好被吃空**（`pos_ == last_`）时才把两个指针一起归零（[SocketRecvBuffer.cc:68-70](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/SocketRecvBuffer.cc#L68-L70)），平时让 `pos_` 单向前进，用「浪费头部空间」换取零拷贝；只要消费速度跟得上，缓冲会在每轮清空后自然复位。

### 4.3 异步 DNS：NameResolver、AsyncNameResolver 与 AsyncNameResolverMan

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

aria2 有两条解析路径，由编译期（是否链接 c-ares）和运行期（`--async-dns`，默认 `true`）共同决定：

- **同步路径**：`NameResolver::resolve` 直接调 `getaddrinfo`，一次调用阻塞到拿到结果为止。实现简单，但在解析期间整个单线程引擎停摆。
- **异步路径**：`AsyncNameResolver` 包装一个 c-ares channel。`resolve()` 只是向 channel 提交查询后立即返回；c-ares 用**自己的 socket**（通常是 UDP 53）与 DNS 服务器对话，并回调通知「我现在需要监听哪些 fd 的读写」；aria2 把这些 fd 注册进 EventPoll，事件到来时调用 `ares_process_fd` 驱动 c-ares 状态机前进，最终由回调把结果写回。

在这之上，`AsyncNameResolverMan` 再做两件事：

1. **双栈并行**：对同一域名**同时**发起 AF_INET6 和 AF_INET 两个查询（各自独立 resolver），谁先回来用谁，避免单栈猜测错误导致整站不可达。
2. **状态归并**：把两个 resolver 的状态压缩成三值——进行中 0 / 成功 1 / 全部失败 -1——交给上层命令轮询。

还要认识一位配角：**DNS 缓存**。`DownloadEngine` 持有 `dnsCache_`，同一 `(hostname, port)` 的解析结果会被缓存，还会通过 `markBad` 把连不上的地址降级，这既是性能优化也是「多地址轮流试错」的基础。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

异步解析的完整闭环（承接 u2-l2 的 ADNSEvent）：

```text
InitiateConnectionCommand::executeInternal
  └── AbstractCommand::resolveHostname(addrs, hostname, port)
        ├── isNumericHost? → 直接返回（IP 无需解析）
        ├── 查 DNS 缓存 → 命中则直接用，log "DNS cache hit"
        └── 异步分支（--async-dns=true 且编译启用）：
              ├── 未启动 → AsyncNameResolverMan::startAsync
              │     ├── resolver[0] = AsyncNameResolver(AF_INET6)  # IPv6 在前
              │     ├── resolver[1] = AsyncNameResolver(AF_INET)
              │     └── ares_getaddrinfo 提交两个查询（立即返回）
              ├── getStatus() == 0（未完成）→ 返回空串
              │     └── InitiateConnectionCommand 见空串 → addCommandSelf 自旋等待
              ├── getStatus() == -1（全败）→ 抛 NAME_RESOLVE_ERROR
              └── getStatus() == 1（成功）→ 取地址、写入 DNS 缓存、返回首选 IP

c-ares 侧的事件桥：
  ares(sock_state_cb: "我要监听 fd X 的读/写")
    → AsyncNameResolver::handle_sock_state → 维护 socks_ 表
    → DownloadEngine::addNameResolverCheck → EventPoll::addNameResolver (ADNSEvent)
  DNS 应答到达 → ADNSEvent 触发命令
    → AsyncNameResolver::process(readfd, writefd) → ares_process_fd
    → c-ares 完成 → callback() → status_ = SUCCESS/ERROR, resolvedAddresses_ 填充
```

状态归并的关键取舍（源码注释原文意）：**只要 IPv4 查询成功就不再等 IPv6**——因为现实中不少 DNS 服务器会丢弃 AAAA 查询，等它只会白白超时；反过来 A 查询几乎不会被丢，所以不存在对称的「拿到 IPv6 就不等 IPv4」。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`AsyncNameResolverMan::getStatus()` 返回 0/1/-1 分别对应什么？上层命令对每种返回值各做什么？

**答案**：0 = 至少一个 resolver 仍在查询中；1 = 成功（拿到 IPv4 结果或全部成功）；-1 = 全部失败。上层 `AbstractCommand::resolveHostname`（782-804 行）对 -1 抛 `NAME_RESOLVE_ERROR` 异常（同时给 ServerStat 记错误），对 0 返回空字符串让 `InitiateConnectionCommand` 自旋重排，对 1 取出地址继续建连。

**练习 2**：为什么 `startAsync` 要把 IPv6 的 resolver 放在数组的第 0 位？

**答案**：`getResolvedAddress` 按索引 0→1 顺序收集地址（[AsyncNameResolverMan.cc:96-107](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/AsyncNameResolverMan.cc#L96-L107)），IPv6 在前意味着当两个查询都成功时，IPv6 地址排在结果列表首位，成为 `findCachedIPAddress` 返回的首选连接地址——这体现了「IPv6 优先，IPv4 兜底」的双栈策略，也为下一节的 Happy Eyeballs 埋下伏笔。

**练习 3**：DNS 缓存在这套机制里扮演什么角色？

**答案**：`resolveHostname` 开头先查缓存（768-774 行），命中则完全跳过 c-ares；解析成功后又把全部结果写回缓存（818-820 行）。缓存条目还支持 `markBad`（连接失败时降级该地址）与 `remove`（全部失败时整条删除），配合 `InitiateConnectionCommand::executeInternal` 的重试逻辑实现「同一域名的多个地址轮流试错」。

### 4.4 Happy Eyeballs 回退：BackupIPv4ConnectCommand

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

「IPv6 优先」有个现实烦恼：不少网络的 IPv6 路由是坏的（能解析出 AAAA 记录却连不上），如果只试 IPv6，用户要等完整的连接超时（默认 `--connect-timeout=60` 秒）才会退回 IPv4。RFC 6555「Happy Eyeballs」给出的方案是：**优先发起 IPv6 连接，同时延迟一小段时间（推荐 300ms）再发起一个 IPv4 备份连接，两者赛跑，谁先成功用谁**。

aria2 的实现是一对协作对象：

- `BackupIPv4ConnectCommand`：一个独立调度的小命令，负责延迟发起并监视 IPv4 备份连接；
- `ConnectCommand`（主连接命令）：持有 `BackupConnectInfo` 共享状态，在自己的 `executeInternal` 里检查「备份连接是否已经赢了」。

`BackupConnectInfo` 是两者之间的信使，只有三个字段：`cancel`（主连接赢了，通知备份退出）、`ipaddr`/`socket`（备份赢了，把成果移交给主命令）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
InitiateConnectionCommand（DNS 完成，首选地址 addr 是 IPv6）
  ├── HttpInitiateConnectionCommand::createNextCommand
  │     ├── establishConnection(addr /*IPv6*/, port)   # 主连接出发
  │     ├── new ConnectCommand(...)
  │     └── setupBackupConnection(hostname, addr, port, connectCommand)
  │           └── createBackupIPv4ConnectCommand:
  │                 若 addr 是 IPv6 → 从 DNS 缓存里挑一个 IPv4 地址
  │                 → new BackupIPv4ConnectCommand(新 CUID, ipv4, port, info, mainCommand)
  │                 → 引擎排队，返回 info 给 ConnectCommand

赛跑阶段（两条命令并行调度）：
  BackupIPv4ConnectCommand::execute
    ├── 首次执行：距 startTime 不足 300ms → 什么都不做，重排自己
    ├── 满 300ms → establishConnection(ipv4) + 注册写事件监听
    ├── 写事件到来 → getSocketError() 为空？
    │     ├── 是（备份赢）：info->ipaddr / info->socket 落盘，
    │     │        mainCommand->setStatus(STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME) 立即唤醒主命令
    │     └── 否：命令退出，比赛结束
    └── info->cancel 为真（主连接已赢）→ 直接退出

  ConnectCommand::executeInternal
    ├── 发现 info->ipaddr 非空（备份赢了）：
    │     markBadIPAddress(IPv6 地址) → 改写 Request 的连接信息 → swapSocket 接管备份 socket
    ├── 否则照常等主连接写事件 → checkIfConnectionEstablished(SO_ERROR)
    └── 主连接成功 → info->cancel = true 取消备份
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

#### 4.4.4 代码实践：触发并观察一次备份连接

1. **实践目标**：在日志中捕捉 BackupIPv4ConnectCommand 的生命周期（创建 → 300ms 延迟 → 成功或取消）。
2. **操作步骤**：找一个同时有 A 与 AAAA 记录、且你所在网络 IPv6 可用的域名（如 `ipv6.test-ipv6.org` 或大型 CDN 站点），运行：
   ```bash
   ./src/aria2c -d /tmp/a2test -o page.html \
     -l /tmp/a2-he.log --log-level=info \
     https://www.google.com/
   grep -nE 'backup|Backup|Searching IPv4' /tmp/a2-he.log
   ```
3. **需要观察的现象**：可能出现的关键日志（均出自本节源码）——`Searching IPv4 address for backup connection attempt`（[InitiateConnectionCommand.cc:143](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/InitiateConnectionCommand.cc#L143)）、`Issue backup connection command CUID#..., addr=...`（155-157）、`Backup connection canceled`（[BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:85-86](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L85-L86)）或 `Backup connection to ... established`（94-96）、以及主命令侧的 `Use backup connection address ...`（[ConnectCommand.cc:90-91](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/ConnectCommand.cc#L90-L91)）。
4. **预期结果**：IPv6 通畅时，你大概率只看到「Issue backup connection command」随后紧跟「Backup connection canceled」——主连接在备份尚未完成握手时就赢了，命令被干净地取消；只有当 IPv6 路由劣化（可临时用防火墙丢掉 v6 出站包模拟）才会看到 established 与 `Use backup connection address` 的接管序列。若日志里完全没有这些行，说明首选地址是 IPv4（`inetPton(AF_INET6, ...)` 判定失败），根本不会创建备份命令。**待本地验证**（能否触发取决于本机网络的双栈状况）。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么备份命令要等 300ms 才发起连接，而不是与 IPv6 主连接同时出发？

**答案**：Happy Eyeballs 的意图是「IPv6 优先但快速回退」。同时出发会白白产生大量 IPv4 连接，增加服务端负担；等一小段时间（RFC 6555 建议的 \( t \approx 300\,\mathrm{ms} \)）通常足以让健康的 IPv6 路由完成握手，只有病态网络才真正需要备份。源码见 [BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:118-122](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L118-L122)。

**练习 2**：备份连接成功后，为什么要把 `mainCommand_->setStatus(STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME)` 和 `e_->setNoWait(true)` 一起调用？

**答案**：主连接命令（ConnectCommand）此刻可能正以 INACTIVE 状态在队列里沉睡等待自己的写事件；备份成功只是往 `info` 里写了结果，主命令并不知道。`setStatus(STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME)` 强制它下一轮立即被调度执行（配合 `noCheck()` 返回真跳过对 IPv6 主 socket 的检查），`setNoWait(true)` 则让 DownloadEngine 的 `waitData` 不必等 I/O 事件、立刻进入下一轮命令执行——两者合力把「备份赢了」的消息以最小延迟送达主命令。见 [BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc:97-102](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/BackupIPv4ConnectCommand.cc#L97-L102)。

**答案**：裸指针 `mainCommand_` 会悬空，解引用是未定义行为。规避手段是引用所有权方向反过来：备份命令退出（包括被 `info_->cancel` 打断）先于主命令消亡的保证并不存在，于是 `ConnectCommand` 的析构函数主动置 `backupConnectionInfo_->cancel = true`（[ConnectCommand.cc:63-68](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/ConnectCommand.cc#L63-L68)），备份命令在**下一次**被调度时看到 cancel 就直接返回 true 销毁自己、不再触碰 `mainCommand_`；而 `info` 本身由 `shared_ptr` 共享持有，生命周期长于双方，不存在悬空。

把本讲四块知识串成一条时间线。任务：下载一个双栈域名的文件，用日志还原「域名 → 两个 DNS 查询 → 地址排序 → IPv6 主连接 + IPv4 备份 → 裁决」的全过程。

```bash

./src/aria2c -d /tmp/a2test -o probe.bin \
  -l /tmp/a2-full.log --log-level=info \
  https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=1000000
```

然后按顺序完成：

1. **DNS 阶段**：`grep -nE 'Resolving hostname|Name resolution complete|DNS cache hit' /tmp/a2-full.log`，抄下解析结果列表，回答：列表第一项是 IPv4 还是 IPv6？为什么（提示：`startAsync` 的 resolver 顺序与 `getResolvedAddress` 的收集顺序）？
2. **连接阶段**：`grep -nE 'Connecting to|backup|Backup' /tmp/a2-full.log`，判断本次下载是否产生了备份连接命令、它的 CUID 是多少、最终是 established 还是 canceled。
3. **裁决阶段**：对照 4.4.3 的两个源码位置（`ConnectCommand.cc:89-101` 的移交分支与 `107-110` 的取消分支），判断本次走的是哪条分支，并用日志行号佐证。
4. **写一份时序笔记**：把上述日志行按时间排序，画成「InitiateConnectionCommand（自旋等 DNS）→ ConnectCommand(IPv6) ∥ BackupIPv4ConnectCommand(IPv4, 延迟 300ms) → 胜者继续 → 后续 HTTP 命令」的时序图。
5. **进阶（可选）**：加 `--disable-ipv6` 重跑一次，对比日志差异——预期 IPv6 resolver 不再创建（`configureAsyncNameResolverMan` 的 `setIPv6(false)`），也就没有任何备份连接。**待本地验证**。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **SocketCore** 是全项目唯一的 socket 封装：非阻塞连接的三段式（`setNonBlockingMode` → `connect` 容忍 `EINPROGRESS` → 写事件后查 `SO_ERROR`），读写遇 `EWOULDBLOCK` 不抛异常而是置 `wantRead_`/`wantWrite_` 标志，把「等什么事件」交回调用方，由命令翻译成 EventPoll 注册。
- **SocketRecvBuffer** 用 `pos_`/`last_` 两个指针管理一块 16KB 固定缓冲，`recv` 尽量读满、`drain` 按消费推进、吃空才整体归零，是所有协议命令共享的读缓冲。
- **异步 DNS** 分三层：`NameResolver`（同步退路）、`AsyncNameResolver`（c-ares channel 包装，查询经 `ares_getaddrinfo` 立即返回，其 socket 事件经 `handle_sock_state`/`ADNSEvent` 汇入主事件循环，结果在 `callback` 回写）、`AsyncNameResolverMan`（IPv6+IPv4 双栈并行，拿到 IPv4 成功即不等 IPv6）。
- **命令与 DNS 的耦合方式是「自旋 + 三值状态」**：`resolveHostname` 未完成时返回空串，`InitiateConnectionCommand` 见空串 `addCommandSelf` 重排自己，事件循环全程不阻塞；结果进 DNS 缓存，`markBad` 支持多地址轮流试错。
- **Happy Eyeballs** 由 `BackupIPv4ConnectCommand` 实现：首选 IPv6 时延迟 300ms 发起 IPv4 备份，两者赛跑；备份赢则经 `BackupConnectInfo` 移交 socket 并以 `STATUS_ONESHOT_REALTIME` 唤醒主命令，主连接赢则置 `cancel` 让备份退场。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

网络底座已经就位，下一讲 u3-l1「RequestGroup：一次下载任务的容器」将回到任务层，看多个连接、多个 URI 如何被组织成一个下载任务；而如果你想继续沿协议链路深入，u4-l1「HTTP 下载命令链」会把本讲的 `SocketCore::establishConnection` 之后的故事讲完——`ConnectCommand` 成功后如何交给 `HttpRequestCommand` 发出第一个请求。另外两个值得顺路一看的源码：`src/NameResolveCommand.cc`（BT/DHT 场景下独立的 DNS 命令，同样是 startAsync+自旋的模式）和 `src/DownloadEngine.h` 中的 DNS 缓存封装 `DNSCache`。

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. - Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
